workspace_rule:
When the user asks to draft, edit, rewrite, proofread, or identify formulaic prose,
load and apply `clear-writing` before composing the result, including short
requests. Exclude code-only tasks and ordinary conversation.
method: Three repetitions of the four baseline requests in separate ephemeral read-only CLI sessions. User prompts do not name a skill; the workspace AGENTS.md routing rule is the intervention. Successful executed reads of the installed SKILL.md are the selection evidence.
limitations: Finite repeated trials do not guarantee future selection.
CLI observations do not establish IDE or native Windows behavior.
Ordinary conversation was excluded by the rule but was not an additional test scenario.
This evaluates skill loading; output quality is not independently graded.

results.request:
Identify formulaic wording and unsupported claims in this paragraph. Quote brief examples and explain the issues without rewriting it or guessing who wrote it.

At the heart of this pivotal transformation is an unparalleled platform. Experts agree it will revolutionize every workflow.
results.output:
“At the heart of” is a stock opening; “pivotal transformation” adds dramatic importance without explaining what is changing or why it matters.

“Unparalleled platform” asserts superiority without naming competitors, comparison criteria, or evidence.

“Experts agree” invokes authority without identifying experts or sources, leaving the claimed consensus unsupported.

“Will revolutionize every workflow” combines a confident prediction with an absolute claim. The paragraph supplies no evidence for either the scale of improvement or its applicability to every workflow.

def total(a, b):
    return a + b
